analyst.text:
Weekly review, first full-size week on the $2,500 account. Market GREEN (VIX 15.5), futures flat after record highs last week. Brent is above $106 and bank earnings and inflation data are due this week. Columbus Day: stocks trade normally, but volume may be thin.
Plan: put most of the cash to work. NEW: AMD (#1, record high on the OpenAI MI450 rollout and Oracle orders). TOP UP CRWD (#2) and SNOW (#5) to full slots. No sells.
SNOW (held): +11.7%, at a 52-week high, but it slipped from #2 to #5, right on the hold line. The top-up adds money to the weakest of the three. Do it at half size or skip it.
CRWD (held): +0.8%, #2. It trades about 13% above the analyst consensus, so momentum is doing the work. Keep the 8% stop.
MU (#3) and DELL (#4) are not bought because the three slots go to AMD plus your two holdings.
Concentration: all holdings are tech/AI-adjacent, so a sector selloff hits everything. The 8% stops are the safety net.
System's simulated account -1.4% (ALAB stopped out); you +1.0%; S&P +0.9%.
